I've seen some BLANK portraits (specifically US) you have made a while ago, and I noticed that one of them look like it's based off of Hillary Clinton (female BLANK). So I was wonder what are the people you base the BLANK portraits off of?

Mainly portraits of some presidents like Dylan Price, Oscar Lachman (which reminds me of Jimmy Fallon), Carla Anderson (which reminds me of Ellen DeGeneres for some reason), Thang Levin, Lionel Halvidar (modified Woodrow Wilson?), and Dom Terragno. (which I have an interest in)<ac_metadata title="who are some of the BLANK portraits based off of?"> </ac_metadata>
